# StructureDurability

`world-system`

How a placed block wears and comes apart. Its durability starts at its material's and falls with weather, age and damage; at zero it is destroyed. Destruction methods damage some classes more than others, and do so offlineFactor times more slowly while every owner is offline. A destroyer gets nothing. The owner repairs with part of the build materials, and dismantling returns a share that rises with Building skill and falls with durability.

> Let anyone break a building, but only with effort (DurabilityAndDestruction, Phase 203)

## Actions

### wear

Lower a block's durability by age and weather

**Conditions:**
- Computed from timestamps when a block is read or ticked, never by touching every block every frame

### destroy

A non-owner damages a block with a method

**Conditions:**
- Damage = method damage × class multiplier, divided by offlineFactor while every owner is offline
- The destroyer gets nothing

### repair

The owner restores durability

**Conditions:**
- Costs repair.share of the build materials times the fraction restored, rounded up

### dismantle

The owner (or a clan member, for a member's private house in clan territory) takes a block apart

**Conditions:**
- Returns the dismantle share of its material, by durability and Building level
